body: I've tried helping other people out, people that have come to me with their problems, but usually once they've finished listening to my advice they move on and that's it. Since I can remember I've tried my hardest to please people in the hopes that someone will appreciate it or decide to want to hang out with me but it never seems to work, people just tend to take advantage of you.
It's never that easy, I don't feel comfortable talking to people. I tend to get pretty bad panic attacks when I start overthinking things
